text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's debut race goes<n>without a hitch,
and now it's time to<n>decide our next goal. There are
two<n>paths racers like her usually take.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's the Classic Triple Crown<n>tour, which
consists of the Satsuki<n>Sho, Japanese Derby, and
Kikuka<n>Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And there's the Triple Tiara tour,<n>which consists of
the Oka Sho,<n>Japanese Oaks, and Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: (I should ask Dober which path she prefers.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While I'm pondering such thoughts,<n>two shadows
race beneath the night<n>sky elsewhere...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I did it! Looks like I crossed the<n>finish line
first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you were incredible! I didn't<n>stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, thank you! ♪ It seems all my<n>hard work is
starting to pay off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, Bright, I heard you<n>changed your
training regimen<n>recently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan said you're pushing yourself<n>even harder
than before. She couldn't<n>decide whether to be
worried about<n>you or happy about your growth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well! ♪ Hehe! That does sound like<n>Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not the only one who's<n>different. You've
changed since your<n>debut race too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Have I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, don't tell me you haven't<n>noticed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching you for a long,<n>looong time, so I
can tell that the look<n>in your eyes has changed,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In fact... As you are now, I bet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hm? You bet what, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. Dober, would you happen to<n>have some
free time after this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a stunning view. You can<n>see for miles out
from here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Why did you bring me up here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Look, Dober. I think the Mejiro<n>estate should
be thereabouts in that<n>direction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I still remember the days you and I<n>spent there
together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Remember how we snuck into the<n>library as
children? You held my hand<n>and led me around the
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah... I didn't want to get<n>caught, and you
were determined to<n>leisurely stroll through the
entire<n>place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for always looking out for me,<n>dear Dober!
♪ We saw so many<n>things in the library, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All along the shelves were countless<n>awards—proof
of the remarkable<n>history the Mejiros forged
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, Ryan, Palmer... All of our<n>predecessors
have carried on the<n>Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They refined and improved the legacy<n>they
inherited, and through their<n>efforts, the Mejiro
name remains a<n>bright pinnacle in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And now, it is our turn.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are we to forever remain the "baby<n>Mejiros,"
shielded by the glories of<n>the past, and allowed only
to fawn<n>over famed legacies?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I should think not.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober. I will follow after you and<n>make my own
dazzling debut into the<n>racing world...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
After which, I will follow the path of<n>the Classic
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall be the one to claim the glory<n>that even Ryan
let slip through her<n>fingers. I shall claim the Triple
Crown<n>for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And then, I will forge a new Mejiro<n>legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A... a new legacy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's right. As for you, Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I always thought I would simply stay<n>in the
shadows.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(People like Bright, Ryan, and<n>McQueen can run
toward their glory<n>with strength alone... They're
different from me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Or at least, that's what I thought...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I ran with all my strength! In an actual<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I was able to finish that race<n>because of
everyone's support. It<n>gave me the confidence to
believe<n>I'm a capable racer too.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(So long as I still have that pride<n>within me, then
surely I, too...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do the same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll forge a new legacy too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to race in the Triple Tiara<n>tour and
conquer the Oka Sho,<n>Japanese Oaks, and Shuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do what Ramonu—the<n>Mejiro family's
pride and joy and<n>the first person to win the Triple
Tiara—did and seize all three tiaras<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not letting you blaze a path by<n>yourself. Let's
make history together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's forge new legacies for the<n>Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee. I knew it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I had a feeling you would say that,<n>Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, were you testing me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why, of course not!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I simply wanted to hear you say how<n>you felt in
your own words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You and your mind games...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Take my hand, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Dober and Bright
text_block_list.text:
We're going to win the Triple Crown<n>and Triple
Tiara! We're going to forge<n>new legacies for the
Mejiro<n>family—together!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Their promise echoes toward the<n>setting sun...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That night, Mejiro Dober comes to tell<n>me about her
goals and plans.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And she tells me how she and<n>Mejiro Bright want
to build new<n>Mejiro legacies.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, we decide to set her on the<n>path toward
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to continue the legacy Ramonu<n>left behind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm nowhere near qualified to<n>say such a
thing. I'm still lacking in<n>so many ways.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But—
choice_data_list:
That just means we need to work hard to change
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list:
I'll do everything I can to help you become even
stronger!

I'll do everything I can to help you become even
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even stronger? Geez...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... You're so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I want to compete in the Triple<n>Tiara tour
during my classic year, I<n>should race in the Hanshin
Juvenile<n>Fillies first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I want to compete in the Triple<n>Tiara tour
during my classic year, I<n>should race in the Hanshin
Juvenile<n>Fillies first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to leave my mark at<n>that race first,
then focus on<n>improving for the real show—the
Triple<n>Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Hanshin J.F.,<n>followed by the
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has taken her first bold<n>steps as a
member of the prestigious<n>Mejiro family!
